snippet.title: The personal indie horror game 《Jimmy's No. 44 House"》has finally been launched on Steam
snippet.description: Officially released on July 12th, I am from China and this is my first time making a game. I hope this game can receive more support. Add it to the Steam wishlist. Thank you all.
